meta.title: How We Work: Onboarding, Monthly Close and Review
meta.description: See how Yaqeen Advisory runs your finance function: one-week onboarding, books closed by the 7th, WhatsApp support, regular reviews and careful data handling.

hero.heading: A predictable rhythm, from week one.
hero.text: You always know what happens next, who owns it and when you will hear from us.

rhythmText: The same five stages run for every client, in India and the GCC.

stages.title: Onboarding
items: Bank feeds and software set up
Client folder and WhatsApp group created

stages.title: Monthly close
items: PDF and dashboard link sent on WhatsApp

stages.title: Day to day
items: Upload bills in the WhatsApp group
Reply within your tier’s response time

stages.title: Review
items: One clear action list with owners

stages.title: Year-end
items: Income tax or corporate tax return filed

month.label: All month
month.text: Filings completed ahead of due dates

toolsText: A small, proven stack that your team can use from day one.

stack.title: Accounting
stack.text: Zoho Books or Tally Prime. We work in the system you already use.

stack.title: Payroll
stack.text: Statutory payroll software for PF, ESI, WPS, GOSI, tax and payslips.

stack.title: Documents
stack.text: Google Drive. One organised folder per client.

stack.title: Daily communication
stack.text: WhatsApp Business. One group per client.

stack.title: Dashboards
stack.text: Looker Studio. A link that opens on any phone or laptop.

stack.title: Modelling
stack.text: Excel for forecasts, models and project deliverables.

protect: Written confidentiality and data-protection terms in every engagement.
Role-based access. Each person sees only what their work needs.
Your data stays in accounts you own, so you can always take it with you.
AI is used on business-grade accounts with proper data terms, never on casual consumer tools.
A qualified accountant reviews every output before it reaches you.
Personal data such as employee records is handled in line with applicable data-protection law, including India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
WhatsApp for conversation. Approvals and decisions are confirmed by email and saved in your client folder.
scopeText: The principles that apply to every engagement.

scope.title: Scoped to what applies to you
scope.text: Filings are scoped at onboarding. If you have no GST or TDS obligation, you are not billed for them.

scope.title: Reserved work stays with licensed professionals
scope.text: Statutory audit, tax audit and any work legally reserved for a licensed practitioner is performed by your own appointed professional.

scope.title: Your part
scope.text: Timely upload of documents, access to portals and approvals. Delays on your side can affect deadlines.

scope.title: Government fees and penalties
scope.text: Fees, interest and penalties payable to authorities are paid by you at actuals.

scope.title: Fair use
scope.text: Transaction volume and query limits for each plan are written into your engagement letter. Work beyond them is quoted separately.

scope.title: Accounting frameworks
scope.text: Indian GAAP is standard in India. Ind AS and IFRS are available as add-ons for clients who need them.

scope.title: Changes in law
scope.text: We update scope and thresholds when tax and compliance rules change, and tell you what it means for you.

scope.title: Confidentiality
scope.text: Your information is confidential. It is used only to deliver your engagement.

faqs.a: Every client has a named accountant and a WhatsApp group. A team covers when your accountant is away, and a qualified accountant reviews every deliverable.

faqs.q: Do I have to change my accounting software?
faqs.a: No. We work in Zoho Books or Tally Prime, or the system you already own. If you have none, we help you select and set one up as a project.

AI helps categorise transactions, read bills, match bank lines and draft commentary. It is used on business-grade accounts with proper data terms, and a qualified accountant reviews the output before it reaches you.
